actionConfiguration.body:
UPDATE public."tickets"
SET 
  approvedby = '{{ approvalstatus.selectedOptionValue }}'
WHERE (ticked_id = '{{Tickets.triggeredRow.ticked_id}}')
OR ( ticked_id = '{{ TicketsonProgress.triggeredRow.ticked_id }}')
OR( ticked_id = '{{ TicketsCompletedMIS.triggeredRow.ticked_id }}')
OR( ticked_id = '{{ TicketsCompletedInsights.triggeredRow.ticked_id }}')
OR( ticked_id = '{{ TicketsCompletedDashboard.triggeredRow.ticked_id }}')
OR( ticked_id = '{{ TicketsCompletedAutomation.triggeredRow.ticked_id }}')
OR( ticked_id = '{{ TicketsCompletedAI.triggeredRow.ticked_id }}')
;
